title: Elmhurst 1925 Brown Sugar Oat Milk Latte – Plant-Based, Vegan, Dairy-Free Latte Made of Whole Grain Oats, Cold Brew Premium Arabica with 95mg Caffeine & Real Brown Sugar – 25.4oz (Pack of 6)
features: DELICIOUSLY SWEET & CREAMY: A perfect blend of oatmilk, premium Arabica cold brew, and real brown sugar. This plant-based latte delivers a creamy, comforting flavor with just 5g of sugar and 95mg of caffeine per serving.

CLEAN, SIMPLE INGREDIENTS: No gums, seed oils, emulsifiers, or added junk here! This vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free latte is crafted without artificial flavors, sweeteners, or carrageenan. Enjoy a pure, authentic taste with every glass.

READY IN MINUTES: No need for a barista! This pre-made, ready-to-drink brown sugar latte is perfect for busy mornings. Sip it straight, pour over ice, shake, or steam and foam for an extra creamy, cafe-style frappuccino at home. Spice it up with cinnamon or other flavors to enhance the taste.

SATISFY EVERY CRAVING: Skip the coffee shop lines. From almond to oat milk, walnut to pistachio milk, Elmhurst offers a variety of plant-based beverages. Whether you’re crafting a smooth iced latte or creamy protein coffee drinks, we have many on-the-go milk, latte and creamer options to suit your preferences.

TASTE THE ELMHURST DIFFERENCE: At Elmhurst, we believe plant milk lattes should be as tasty and nutritious as whole grains, nuts, and seeds. That’s why we use only a few simple ingredients, following our “Simpler. Better.” philosophy to create a yummy, no-nonsense treat for you.
